contracts: The Type-0x3B dispatch entry points to the handler that suppresses the Type-0x3A path while PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is active and otherwise falls through.
The Type-0x3D dispatch entry points to the counted gate response that replaces the shared collision template, publishes the response event, and updates the alternate-response latch.
The Type-0x7E dispatch entry points to the scene-transition handler whose resource-mode and threshold logic drives the transition state.
Each promoted pointer retains its original numeric dispatch name as an alias.
limitations: Dispatch entries that share a handler body remain technical when no selector-specific behavior is established.
The promoted names describe handler roles, not the user-facing entities that select them.
